strings.app.title: RemapCopilotKey
strings.hint.sendKey: While the Copilot key is held, the target key stays down and is released together with it.
strings.hint.hotkey: Click a box and press a key to capture it; capture mode ends after one key. The Windows key can be captured too (it will also open the Start menu).
strings.hint.runAsAdmin: When checked, the launched application starts with administrator rights (one UAC prompt).
strings.hint.toggleWindow: When checked, pressing the Copilot key again minimizes or restores the existing window instead of starting another instance.
strings.check.reloadOnChange: Reload automatically when the config file changes
strings.service.description: Runs as a LocalSystem service and hands a high-integrity keyboard hook to the interactive session after logon, so the Copilot key can be remapped to any key, chord or app.
strings.service.error.accessDenied: Access denied. Make sure the configurator itself is running as administrator.
strings.service.error.disabled: The service is set to Disabled. Set its startup type back to Automatic in the service manager and try again.
strings.service.error.markedForDelete: The service is being deleted. Restart Windows, then register again.
strings.service.error.notInstalled: The service is not registered yet. Click "Register" first.
strings.service.error.startTimeout: The service did not reach Running within 20 seconds. Check RemapCopilotKey.boot.log for the reason.
strings.service.error.stopTimeout: The service did not stop within 20 seconds. End RemapCopilotKeyService.exe with Task Manager and try again.
strings.service.error.deleteTimeout: The service stopped, but it is taking longer to disappear from the system (a handle may still be open). Check services.msc after a reboot.
